translations.literal: On gengyin Taiyuan and Yiding troops combined to attack Zhen Prefecture; Wang Rong again reported distress to Youzhou; Li Kuangwei led thirty thousand foot and horse to hurry there.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Taiyuan and Yiding attacked Zhenzhou; Rong called Kuangwei with thirty thousand.

sentences.zh: 時太原之眾軍於常山鎮，易定之眾軍堅固鎮，燕、趙之卒分拒之。

translations.literal: At the time Taiyuan's host encamped at Changshan town and Yiding's host encamped at Jiangu town; Yan and Zhao troops divided to resist them.
translations.idiomatic: Taiyuan camped at Changshan, Yiding at Jiangu; Yan and Zhao divided to resist.

sentences.zh: 三月，克用、處存斂軍而退。

translations.literal: In the third month Keyong and Chuncun gathered troops and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Third month: Keyong and Chuncun withdrew.

sentences.zh: 四月乙亥，左軍中尉西門君遂殺天威軍使賈德晟，時德晟與李順節俱掌天威軍，順節死，中尉惡德晟，誣奏殺之。

translations.literal: On the day yihai Left Army Commander Ximen Junsui killed Tianwei Army commander Jia Desheng; at the time Desheng and Li Shunjie together controlled the Tianwei Army—when Shunjie died the commandants hated Desheng and memorialized falsely to kill him.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Ximen Junsui killed Jia Desheng, co-commander of Tianwei after Shunjie's death.

sentences.zh: 是日，德晟部下千余騎出奔鳳翔，自是岐軍益盛。

translations.literal: That day more than a thousand of Desheng's cavalry fled out to Fengxiang; from then on Qi troops grew stronger.
translations.idiomatic: That day a thousand of Desheng's horse fled to Fengxiang and Qi grew stronger.

sentences.zh: 五月甲辰，制以河南尹張全義檢校司徒、同平章事，兼孟州刺史，充河陽三城節度、孟懷澤觀察等使。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen an edict made Henan Intendant Zhang Quanyi acting Minister of Works and Associate Grand Councillor, concurrent Meng prefect, and military commissioner of Heyang Three Cities with Meng-Huai-Ze observation.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Zhang Quanyi was made Works minister and Heyang commissioner.

sentences.zh: 七月，燕、趙之卒合勢援邢州，太原大將李存信率軍拒於堯山，王鎔大敗而還。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Yan and Zhao troops combined to aid Xing Prefecture; Taiyuan great general Li Cunxin led troops to resist at Yaoshan; Wang Rong was greatly defeated and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: Yan-Zhao aided Xingzhou; Cunxin routed Rong at Yaoshan.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛丑，鳳翔、邠寧之眾攻興元府，陷之。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou Fengxiang and Binning hosts attacked Xingyuan prefecture and took it.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Fengxiang and Binning took Xingyuan.

sentences.zh: 山南西道節度使楊守亮與前左軍中尉楊復恭、判官李巨川突圍而遁，將奔太原。

translations.literal: Jiannan West military commissioner Yang Shouliang together with former Left Army Commander Yang Fugong and aide Li Juchuan broke the encirclement and fled, intending to flee to Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Shouliang, Fugong, and Li Juchuan broke out toward Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 李茂貞表其子繼密權知興元府事。

translations.literal: Li Maozhen memorialized that his son Jimi should act as temporary Xingyuan prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Maozhen made his son Jimi acting Xingyuan governor.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛未朔，華州節度使韓建奏於乾元縣遇興元潰散兵士，擊敗之。

translations.literal: On the first day of the twelfth month, xinwei, Hua military commissioner Han Jian memorialized that at Qianyuan County he encountered scattered troops from defeated Xingyuan and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month xinwei new moon: Han Jian reported defeating Xingyuan fugitives at Qianyuan.

sentences.zh: 其楊守亮、楊復恭並已處斬訖，皆傳首京師。

translations.literal: Yang Shouliang and Yang Fugong had both already been executed; their heads were all sent to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Shouliang and Fugong were executed; their heads reached the capital.

sentences.zh: 景福二年二年春正月辛丑朔，制以權知劍南東川兵馬留後顧彥暉檢校尚書右僕射，兼梓州刺史、御史大夫，充劍南東川節度觀察等使。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jingfu, in the second year of Jingfu, spring, first month, on the day xinchou the new moon, an edict made Gu Yanhui, acting Dongchuan military commissioner, acting Right Vice Director of the Secretariat, concurrent Zi prefect and Censor-in-Chief, and military commissioner and observer of Jiannan East Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Jingfu 2, spring, xinchou new moon: Gu Yanhui was made Dongchuan commissioner.

sentences.zh: 時王建連年攻彥暉，李茂貞欲與建爭東川，故表請彥暉正授旄鉞，示修好也。

translations.literal: At the time Wang Jian had attacked Yanhui for years; Li Maozhen wished to contend with Jian for East Sichuan and therefore memorialized asking that Yanhui receive the full commission as a sign of reconciliation.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jian had besieged Yanhui; Maozhen sought to block him by regularizing Yanhui's commission.

sentences.zh: 二月庚午朔，太原李克用以兵攻鎮州，師出井陘，王鎔懼，再求救於幽州。

translations.literal: On the first day of the second month, gengwu, Taiyuan Li Keyong attacked Zhen Prefecture with troops; the army came out through Jingxing; Wang Rong was afraid and again begged rescue from Youzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Second month gengwu new moon: Keyong attacked Zhenzhou through Jingxing; Rong again called You.

sentences.zh: 甲申，李匡威復來赴援，太原之軍還邢州。

translations.literal: On jiashen Li Kuangwei again came to the rescue; the Taiyuan army returned to Xing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Kuangwei came again; Taiyuan returned to Xingzhou.

sentences.zh: 三月庚子，制以捧日都頭陳珮為廣州刺史、嶺南東道節度使，扈蹕都頭曹誠為黔州刺史、黔中節度使，耀德都頭李鋋為潤州刺史、鎮海軍節度使，宣威都頭孫惟晟為江陵尹、荊南節度使，並加特進、同平章事。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi an edict made Puri company head Chen Pei Guangzhou prefect and Lingnan East military commissioner, imperial escort company head Cao Cheng Qian prefect and Qianzhong military commissioner, Yaode company head Li Gang Run prefect and Zhenhai military commissioner, Xuanwei company head Sun Weisheng Jiangling governor and Jingnan military commissioner—all were also made Special Advancement and Associate Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi five guard captains were made commissioners and associate councillors—Chen Pei, Cao Cheng, Li Gang, Sun Weisheng—and stripped of army command.

sentences.zh: 各令赴鎮，並落軍權。

translations.literal: Each was ordered to proceed to his post and was removed from military authority.
translations.idiomatic: Each was sent to his post and stripped of troops.

sentences.zh: 時朝議以茂貞傲侮王命，武臣難制，欲用杜讓能及親王典禁兵，故罷五將之權，兼以平章事悅其心。

translations.literal: At the time court opinion held that Maozhen insulted imperial orders and military men were hard to control; they wished to use Du Rangneng and imperial princes to command the guard armies, and therefore removed the five commanders' authority, also making them associate councillors to please their hearts.
translations.idiomatic: Court sought to curb Maozhen by giving princes the guards and appeasing the five with councillor titles.

sentences.zh: 太尉杜讓能冊拜，加食邑至六千戶。

translations.literal: Grand Commandant Du Rangneng received investiture; his fief was increased to six thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: Du Rangneng was invested; fief rose to six thousand households.

sentences.zh: 是月，幽州節度使李匡威弟匡籌據幽州，自稱留後，以符追行營兵，兵皆還幽州。

translations.literal: That month You military commissioner Li Kuangwei's younger brother Kuangchou seized Youzhou and styled himself acting commissioner, using talismans to recall encampment troops; the troops all returned to Youzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month Kuangchou seized Youzhou as acting commissioner and recalled the army.

sentences.zh: 匡威既無歸路，遣判官李貞抱入奏，請朝覲。

translations.literal: Kuangwei, having no road of return, sent aide Li Zhenbao to enter court with a memorial asking to attend audience.
translations.idiomatic: Kuangwei, stranded, sent Li Zhenbao to request audience.

sentences.zh: 王鎔感匡威援助之惠，乃築第於恆州，迎匡威處之。

translations.literal: Wang Rong, moved by Kuangwei's grace in aiding him, then built a mansion at Heng Prefecture and welcomed Kuangwei to dwell there.
translations.idiomatic: Rong built a mansion at Hengzhou for the grateful Kuangwei.

sentences.zh: 四月己巳，汴將王重師、牛存節陷徐州，節度使時溥舉家自燔而死。

translations.literal: On the day jisi Bian commanders Wang Zhongshi and Niu Cunjie took Xuzhou; military commissioner Shi Pu's whole family burned themselves to death.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Zhongshi and Cunjie took Xuzhou; Pu's family immolated themselves.

sentences.zh: 朱全忠遣將龐師古守徐州。

translations.literal: Zhu Quanzhong sent commander Pang Shigu to hold Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Quanzhong left Pang Shigu at Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 六月丁酉朔。

translations.literal: On the first day of the sixth month, dingyou, the new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month opened on dingyou.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，幽州節度使李匡威謀害王鎔而奪其帥，恆州三軍攻匡威，殺之。

translations.literal: On yimao You military commissioner Li Kuangwei plotted to harm Wang Rong and seize his command; Heng Prefecture's three armies attacked Kuangwei and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Kuangwei plotted against Rong; Hengzhou troops killed him.

sentences.zh: 戊午，制太尉、門下侍郎、平章事、晉國公杜讓能加食邑至九千戶。

translations.literal: On wuwu an edict made Grand Commandant, Vice Director of the Chancellery, Grand Councillor, Duke of Jin Du Rangneng's fief increase to nine thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Du Rangneng's fief rose to nine thousand households.

sentences.zh: 門下侍郎、吏部尚書、平間事崔昭緯進階光祿大夫，中書侍郎、平章事鄭延昌兼刑部尚書，並加食邑至千戶。

translations.literal: Vice Director of the Chancellery, Minister of Personnel, and Associate Grand Councillor Cui Zhaowei was advanced to Grand Master of Splendid Happiness; Vice Director of the Chancellery and Grand Councillor Zheng Yanchang was made concurrent Minister of Justice—all received added fiefs of one thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Zhaowei advanced to Grand Master of Splendid Happiness; Zheng Yanchang took Justice; each gained a thousand households.

sentences.zh: 以祠部郎中、知制誥陸扆為中書舍人，仍前翰林學士。

translations.literal: Director of Rites Cui Yi was made Drafting Academician of the Secretariat, still continuing as Hanlin Academician.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Yi of Rites became drafting academician and kept Hanlin post.

sentences.zh: 幽州節度使李匡籌遣使檄王鎔，訊殺匡威之罪。

translations.literal: You military commissioner Li Kuangchou sent envoys with a proclamation to Wang Rong, demanding account for killing Kuangwei.
translations.idiomatic: Kuangchou of You demanded Rong answer for Kuangwei's death.

sentences.zh: 二籓結怨，朱全忠遣判官韋震使幽州和解之。

translations.literal: The two circuits nursed grievance; Zhu Quanzhong sent aide Wei Zhen as envoy to Youzhou to reconcile them.
translations.idiomatic: The two feuded; Quanzhong sent Wei Zhen to reconcile them.

sentences.zh: 七月，李克用興兵攻鎮州，敗王鎔軍于平山。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Li Keyong raised troops to attack Zhen Prefecture and defeated Wang Rong's army at Pingshan.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: Keyong beat Rong at Pingshan.

sentences.zh: 鎔懼，乞盟，請以兵糧助攻邢州，許之，克用遂旋軍襄國。

translations.literal: Rong was afraid, begged alliance, and asked to use troops and grain to assist the attack on Xing Prefecture; this was granted, and Keyong thereupon wheeled his army to Xiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Rong sued for peace and offered grain against Xingzhou; Keyong turned to Xiangguo.

sentences.zh: 癸未，制以鳳翔隴州節度使、檢校太尉、中書令、鳳翔尹、上柱國、岐王、食邑四千五百戶李茂貞為興元尹、山南西道節度等使。

translations.literal: On the day guimao an edict made Fengxiang-Long military commissioner, acting Grand Commandant, Director of the Secretariat, Fengxiang governor, Supreme Pillar of State, Prince of Qi with a fief of four thousand five hundred households Li Maozhen Xingyuan governor and Jiannan West military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Maozhen was made Xingyuan governor and Jiannan West commissioner.

sentences.zh: 以中書侍郎、同平章事徐彥若檢校尚書左僕射、同平章事，兼鳳翔尹，充鳳翔隴州節度使。

translations.literal: Vice Director of the Chancellery and Associate Grand Councillor Xu Yanruo was made acting Left Vice Director of the Secretariat and Associate Grand Councillor, concurrent Fengxiang governor, and Fengxiang-Long military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Yanruo was sent to replace Maozhen as Fengxiang commissioner.

sentences.zh: 時茂貞恃兵求兼領山南節度，昭宗久之不行，茂貞表章不遜，深詆時政，上不能容，將加兵問罪，故以彥若代之。

translations.literal: At the time Maozhen relied on troops to seek concurrent command of the southern mountains circuit; Zhaozong long withheld it; Maozhen's memorials were insubordinate and deeply reviled current policy; the emperor could not bear it and was about to question him with troops, and therefore Yanruo replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: Maozhen had demanded the south; Zhaozong refused; insolent memorials led to Xu Yanruo's replacement mission.

sentences.zh: 八月丙申朔，以嗣覃王為京西招討使，神策大將軍李钅歲副之。

translations.literal: On the first day of the eighth month, bingshen, the Heir Apparent Prince of Qin was made western suppression commissioner, with Shence great general Li Sui as deputy.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month bingshen new moon: Prince of Qin led western suppression; Li Sui was deputy.

sentences.zh: 九月丙寅朔，以武勝軍防禦使錢鏐為鎮海軍節度、浙江西道觀察處置等使，仍移鎮海軍額於杭州。

translations.literal: On the first day of the ninth month, bingyin, Wusheng defense commissioner Qian Liu was made Zhenhai military commissioner and Zhexi West observer with disposition, and the Zhenhai army designation was still moved to Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month bingyin new moon: Qian Liu was made Zhenhai commissioner at Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，覃王率扈駕五十四軍進攻岐陽，屯于興平。

translations.literal: On yihai the Prince of Qin led fifty-four imperial escort armies to attack Qiyang, encamping at Xingping.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai the Prince of Qin attacked Qiyang from Xingping with fifty-four escort armies.

sentences.zh: 李茂貞以兵逆戰，屯於盭厔。

translations.literal: Li Maozhen met the attack with troops, encamping at Zhiyu.
translations.idiomatic: Maozhen met him and camped at Zhiyu.

sentences.zh: 壬午，岐軍進迫興平，王師自潰。

translations.literal: On renwu Qi troops advanced pressing Xingping and the imperial army scattered of itself.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Qi troops pressed Xingping and the imperial army collapsed.

sentences.zh: 茂貞乘勝逼京師，進屯三橋。

translations.literal: Maozhen pressed his victory toward the capital, advancing to encamp at Sanqiao.
translations.idiomatic: Maozhen pursued to Sanqiao outside the capital.

sentences.zh: 甲申，昭宗御安福門，斬觀軍容使西門君遂、內樞密使李周潼，遣中使賜茂貞詔，令收兵歸鎮。

translations.literal: On jiashen Zhaozong attended Anfu Gate, beheaded Army Commissioner Ximen Junsui and Palace Secretary Li Zhoutong, sent palace envoys with an edict to Maozhen ordering him to gather troops and return to his commission.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Zhaozong beheaded Ximen Junsui and Li Zhoutong and ordered Maozhen to withdraw.

sentences.zh: 茂貞陳兵臨皋驛，數宰臣杜讓能之罪，請誅之。

translations.literal: Maozhen arrayed troops at Lingao Post, repeatedly listing chief minister Du Rangneng's crimes and asking that he be executed.
translations.idiomatic: Maozhen camped at Lingao Post and demanded Du Rangneng's death.

sentences.zh: 制貶太尉、平章事、晉國公杜讓能為雷州司戶。

translations.literal: An edict demoted Grand Commandant, Grand Councillor, Duke of Jin Du Rangneng to Lei Prefecture census officer.
translations.idiomatic: Du Rangneng was demoted to Lei census officer.

sentences.zh: 十月乙未，賜杜讓能自盡，其弟戶部侍郎弘徽坐讓能賜死。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei Du Rangneng was ordered to take his own life; his younger brother Vice Minister of Revenue Honghui was condemned with Rangneng and granted death.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Rangneng was ordered to die; brother Honghui died with him.

sentences.zh: 十一月，制以鳳翔節度使李茂貞守中書令，進封秦王，兼興元尹、山南西道節度使。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month an edict made Fengxiang military commissioner Li Maozhen acting Director of the Secretariat, advanced to Prince of Qin, and concurrent Xingyuan governor and Jiannan West military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month: Maozhen was made Secretariat director and Prince of Qin with Xingyuan.

sentences.zh: 邠州節度使王行瑜賜號「尚父」，賜鐵券。

translations.literal: Bin military commissioner Wang Xingyu was granted the title "Sage Father" and bestowed an iron certificate.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Xingyu of Bin was titled Sage Father and given an iron certificate.

sentences.zh: 以門下侍郎、吏部尚書、平章事、監修國史崔昭緯兼尚書左僕射，充諸道鹽鐵轉運等使；

translations.literal: Vice Director of the Chancellery, Minister of Personnel, Associate Grand Councillor, and supervisor of the national history Cui Zhaowei was made concurrent Left Vice Director of the Secretariat and commissioner of salt and iron transport for all circuits;
translations.idiomatic: Cui Zhaowei took Left Vice Director and salt transport;

sentences.zh: 以特進、行右僕射韋昭度為司空、門下侍郎、同平章事、弘文館大學士、太清宮使、延資庫使。

translations.literal: Special Advancement and acting Right Vice Director Wei Zhaodu was made Minister of Works, Vice Director of the Chancellery, Associate Grand Councillor, University Fellow of the Hongwen Institute, Commissioner of the Grand Pure Palace, and Commissioner of the Extended Resources Store.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Zhaodu returned as Works minister and associate councillor;

sentences.zh: 中書侍郎、刑部尚書、平章事、判度支鄭延昌罷知政事，守尚書左僕射，以病求罷故也。

translations.literal: Vice Director of the Chancellery, Minister of Justice, Grand Councillor, and judge of Revenue Zheng Yanchang ceased knowing government affairs and remained Left Vice Director of the Secretariat, because he asked to leave on grounds of illness.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Yanchang left council over illness but kept Left Vice Director;

sentences.zh: 以新除鳳翔節度使徐彥若復知政事。

translations.literal: The newly appointed Fengxiang military commissioner Xu Yanruo again knew government affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Yanruo of Fengxiang returned to council.

sentences.zh: 戶部侍郎、判戶部事王搏本官同平章事。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Revenue and judge of Revenue affairs Wang Bo was confirmed in office as Associate Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Bo of Revenue became Associate Grand Councillor.

sentences.zh: 乾寧元年乾甯元年春正月乙丑朔，上御武德殿受朝，宣制大赦，改元乾寧。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianning, in the first year of Qianning, spring, first month, on the day yichou the new moon, the emperor attended court at Wude Hall, proclaimed an amnesty edict, and changed the era to Qianning.
translations.idiomatic: Qianning 1, spring, first month yichou new moon: court at Wude Hall, amnesty, era Qianning.

sentences.zh: 鳳翔李茂貞來朝，大陳兵衛，獻妓女三十人，宴之內殿，數日還籓。

translations.literal: Fengxiang Li Maozhen came to court, greatly arrayed armed guards, presented thirty singing girls, feasted him in the inner hall, and after several days he returned to his circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Maozhen came to court with a great guard, gave thirty singers, feasted in the inner hall, then returned.

sentences.zh: 時茂貞有山南梁、洋、興、鳳、岐、隴、秦、涇、原等十五餘郡，甲兵雄盛，淩弱王室，頗有問鼎之志。

translations.literal: At the time Maozhen held more than fifteen commanderies of Liang, Yang, Xing, Feng, Qi, Long, Qin, Jing, Yuan, and others; his armored troops were mighty and he bullied the weakened royal house, quite having the ambition to seize the tripod.
translations.idiomatic: Maozhen held fifteen southern commanderies, bullied the court, and eyed the throne.

sentences.zh: 二月，汴人大敗兗、鄆之軍于東阿，瑄、瑾勢蹙，求援于太原，李克用出師援之。

translations.literal: In the second month Bian troops greatly defeated Yan and Yun armies at Dong'e; Xuan and Jin were cornered and sought aid from Taiyuan; Li Keyong marched out to rescue them.
translations.idiomatic: Second month: Bian crushed Yan-Yun at Dong'e; Xuan and Jin called Keyong.

sentences.zh: 三月甲子朔，太原軍攻邢州，陷之，執其逆將李存孝，檻送太原，裂之。

translations.literal: On the first day of the third month, jiazi, Taiyuan troops attacked Xing Prefecture, took it, seized the rebel commander Li Cunxiao, sent him in a cage to Taiyuan, and dismembered him.
translations.idiomatic: Third month jiazi new moon: Taiyuan took Xingzhou, caged Cunxiao, and executed him.

sentences.zh: 克用以大將馬師素權知邢洺團練事。

translations.literal: Keyong made his great general Ma Shisu acting Xing-Min training commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Keyong made Ma Shisu acting Xing-Min commander.

sentences.zh: 五月，蔡賊孫儒部將劉建鋒攻陷潭州，自稱湖南節度使。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Cai rebel Sun Ru's officer Liu Jianfeng attacked and took Tan Prefecture and styled himself Hunan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month: Liu Jianfeng of Sun Ru's army took Tanzhou and claimed Hunan.

sentences.zh: 以翰林學士、中書舍人陸扆為戶部侍郎、知制誥，充職。

translations.literal: Hanlin Academician and Drafting Academician of the Secretariat Cui Yi was made Vice Minister of Revenue and drafter of edicts, fulfilling duty.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Yi was made Revenue vice minister and kept drafting duty.

sentences.zh: 六月壬辰，李克用攻陷雲州，執大同防禦使赫連鐸，以其牙將薛志勤守雲中。

translations.literal: On the day renchen Li Keyong attacked and took Yun Prefecture, seized Datong defense commissioner Helian Duo, and made his guard officer Xue Zhiqin hold Yunzhong.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Keyong took Yunzhou, seized Helian Duo, and left Xue Zhiqin at Yunzhong.

sentences.zh: 十月庚寅，以中書侍郎、平章事王搏為湖南節度使。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin Vice Director of the Chancellery and Grand Councillor Wang Bo was made Hunan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Wang Bo was sent as Hunan commissioner.

sentences.zh: 以翰林學士承旨、禮部尚書、知制誥李磎為戶部侍郎、同平章事。

translations.literal: Hanlin Academician-in-Chief, Minister of Rites, and drafter of edicts Li Di was made Vice Minister of Revenue and Associate Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: Li Di was made Revenue vice minister and associate councillor.

sentences.zh: 宣制之日，水部郎中、知制誥劉崇魯出班而泣，言磎奸邪，黨附內官，不可居輔弼之地，由是制命不行。

translations.literal: On the day the edict was proclaimed, Director of the Water Office and drafter of edicts Liu Chonglu came out of rank weeping, saying Di was treacherous and wicked, clique-attached to inner officials, and could not occupy the place of chief assistant—therefore the edict order did not proceed.
translations.idiomatic: When Li Di's appointment was read, Liu Chonglu wept in open court that Di was wicked and eunuch-backed; the order failed.

sentences.zh: 戊申，制御史中丞崔胤為兵部侍郎、同平章事。

translations.literal: On wushen an edict made Censor-in-Chief Cui Yin Vice Minister of War and Associate Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Cui Yin became War vice minister and associate councillor.

sentences.zh: 是月，李克用以太原之眾進攻幽州。

translations.literal: That month Li Keyong advanced with Taiyuan's host to attack Youzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month Keyong marched on Youzhou.

sentences.zh: 十二月，幽州節度使李匡籌潰圍而遁。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month You military commissioner Li Kuangchou broke the encirclement and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month: Kuangchou broke out and fled.

sentences.zh: 克用陷幽州，以李匡威故將劉仁恭為幽州兵為留後。

translations.literal: Keyong took Youzhou and made Li Kuangwei's former commander Liu Rengong acting You military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Keyong took Youzhou and made Liu Rengong acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 是月，李匡籌南奔赴關，至景城，為滄州節度使盧彥威所殺。

translations.literal: That month Li Kuangchou fled south toward the pass; at Jing Prefecture he was killed by Cangzhou military commissioner Lu Yanwei.
translations.idiomatic: That month Kuangchou fled south and was killed by Lu Yanwei at Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 乾寧二年二年春正月己未朔，河中節度使、檢校太師、中書令、河中尹、上柱國、琅邪郡王王重盈卒，三軍立重榮子行軍司馬珂知留後事。

translations.literal: In the second year of Qianning, in the second year of Qianning, spring, first month, on the day jiwei the new moon, Hezhong military commissioner, acting Grand Preceptor, Director of the Secretariat, Hezhong governor, Supreme Pillar of State, Prince of Langye Wang Chongying died; the three armies established Chongying's son marching chief Ke to know acting commissioner affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Qianning 2, spring, jiwei new moon: Wang Chongying of Hezhong died; his son Ke became acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 二月己丑朔，王重盈子陝州節度使珙、絳州刺史瑤舉兵討王珂，兼上章訴珂冒姓，非重榮子。

translations.literal: On the first day of the second month, jichou, Chongying's son Shan military commissioner Gong and Jiang prefect Yao raised troops to attack Wang Ke, and also submitted memorials accusing Ke of falsely claiming the surname and not being Chongrong's son.
translations.idiomatic: Second month jichou new moon: Gong and Yao attacked Ke and accused him of false lineage.

sentences.zh: 珂、珙爭為蒲帥，上遣中使慰勞。

translations.literal: Ke and Gong contended for command of Pu; the emperor sent palace envoys to comfort and instruct them.
translations.idiomatic: Ke and Gong fought for Hezhong; envoys were sent to calm them.

sentences.zh: 三月，制以中書侍郎、同平章事崔胤檢校尚書左僕射、同平章事、河中尹，充河中節度、晉絳慈隰觀察處置等使。

translations.literal: In the third month an edict made Vice Director of the Chancellery and Associate Grand Councillor Cui Yin acting Left Vice Director of the Secretariat, Associate Grand Councillor, Hezhong governor, and military commissioner of Hezhong with Jin-Jiang-Ci-Wei observation and disposition.
translations.idiomatic: Third month: Cui Yin was made Hezhong commissioner to settle the feud.

sentences.zh: 浙東節度使董昌僭號稱羅平國，年稱大聖，用婺州刺史蔣瑰為宰相，仍偽署官員。

translations.literal: Zhedong military commissioner Dong Chang arrogated the title State of Luoping, styled his era Great Sage, used Wu prefect Jiang Kui as chief minister, and still falsely appointed officials.
translations.idiomatic: Dong Chang of Zhedong declared Luoping, era Great Sage, with Jiang Kui as false chancellor.

sentences.zh: 鎮海軍節度使錢鏐請以本軍進討，從之。

translations.literal: Zhenhai military commissioner Qian Liu asked to lead his army to campaign against him; the request was assented to.
translations.idiomatic: Qian Liu asked to campaign against Dong Chang; the edict was assented to.

sentences.zh: 以翰林學士承旨、兵部侍郎、知制誥趙光逢為尚書左丞，依前充職。

translations.literal: Hanlin Academician-in-Chief, Vice Minister of War, and drafter of edicts Zhao Guangfeng was made Left Vice Director of the Secretariat, continuing in his former duty.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Guangfeng was made Left Vice Director and kept Hanlin duty.

sentences.zh: 太原李克用上章言王重榮有功于國，其子珂宜承襲，請賜節鉞。

translations.literal: Taiyuan Li Keyong submitted a memorial saying Wang Chongrong had merit to the state and his son Ke should inherit; he asked that the commission be granted.
translations.idiomatic: Keyong memorialized that Ke should inherit Chongrong's Hezhong commission.

sentences.zh: 邠州王行瑜、鳳翔李茂貞、華州韓建各上章，言珂螟蛉，不宜纘襲，請以王珂為陝州，王珙為河中。

translations.literal: Binzhou Wang Xingyu, Fengxiang Li Maozhen, and Huazhou Han Jian each submitted memorials saying Ke was an adopted son unfit to succeed and asking that Ke be made Shan military commissioner and Gong Hezhong.
translations.idiomatic: Xingyu, Maozhen, and Han Jian called Ke a usurper and asked to split Hezhong between Ke and Gong.

sentences.zh: 天子以先允克用之奏，久之不下。

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven, having earlier assented to Keyong's memorial, long withheld the edict.
translations.idiomatic: Having favored Keyong's plea, the emperor stalled the edict.

sentences.zh: 五月丁巳朔。

translations.literal: On the first day of the fifth month, dingsi, the new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month opened on dingsi.

sentences.zh: 甲子，李茂貞、王行瑜、韓建等各率精甲數千人入覲，京師大恐，人皆亡竄，吏不能止。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi Li Maozhen, Wang Xingyu, Han Jian, and others each led several thousand picked armored troops to attend audience; the capital was greatly afraid and people all fled and hid; clerks could not stop them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Maozhen, Xingyu, and Han Jian entered the capital with thousands of picked troops; the city panicked.

sentences.zh: 昭宗御安福門以俟之，三帥既至，拜舞樓下，昭宗臨軒自諭之曰：「卿等籓侯，宜存臣節，稱兵入朝，不由奏請，意在何也？

translations.literal: Zhaozong attended Anfu Gate to wait for them; when the three commanders arrived they bowed below the tower; Zhaozong faced the balustrade and instructed them himself, saying: "You are feudal lords and should preserve ministerial conduct; raising troops to enter court without memorial request—what is your intent?"
translations.idiomatic: Zhaozong waited at Anfu Gate and asked the three commanders why they brought armies to court unbidden.

sentences.zh: 」茂貞、行瑜汗流洽背，不能對，唯韓建陳敘入覲之由。

translations.literal: Maozhen and Xingyu sweated until back and robe were soaked and could not reply; only Han Jian stated the reason for attending audience.
translations.idiomatic: Maozhen and Xingyu could not answer; only Han Jian explained.

sentences.zh: 上並召升樓，賜之卮酒，宴之于同文殿。

translations.literal: The emperor summoned them all to ascend the tower, bestowed cups of wine, and feasted them in Tongwen Hall.
translations.idiomatic: He brought them up, gave wine, and feasted them at Tongwen Hall.

sentences.zh: 茂貞、行瑜極言南北司相傾，深蠹時政，請誅其太甚者。

translations.literal: Maozhen and Xingyu spoke urgently that northern and southern offices opposed each other and deeply poisoned current government, asking to execute the most excessive.
translations.idiomatic: They demanded execution of the worst northern and southern office rivals.

sentences.zh: 乃貶宰相韋昭度、李磎，尋殺之於都亭驛，殺內官數人而去。

translations.literal: Thereupon chief ministers Wei Zhaodu and Li Di were demoted, and soon killed at Duting Post; several inner officials were killed and they departed.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Zhaodu and Li Di were demoted, killed at Duting, and several eunuchs died.

sentences.zh: 王行瑜留弟行約，茂貞留假子閻圭，各以兵二千人宿衛。

translations.literal: Wang Xingyu left his younger brother Xingyue; Maozhen left his adopted son Yan Gui—each with two thousand troops as palace guard.
translations.idiomatic: Xingyu left Xingyue and Maozhen left Yan Gui with two thousand guards each.

sentences.zh: 時三帥同謀廢昭宗立吉王，聞太原起軍乃止，留兵宿衛而還。

translations.literal: At the time the three commanders together plotted to depose Zhaozong and install the Prince of Ji; hearing Taiyuan had raised troops they stopped, left troops as guards, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: They had plotted to depose Zhaozong for the Prince of Ji but withdrew when Taiyuan marched, leaving guards.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以責授均州司戶孔緯、繡州司戶張浚並為太子賓客。

translations.literal: On the day renshen the demoted Jun census officer Kong Wei and the demoted Xiu census officer Zhang Jun were both made Junior Tutors to the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Kong Wei and Zhang Jun were made Junior Tutors.

sentences.zh: 以翰林學士、戶部侍郎、知制誥陸扆為兵部侍郎，充職。

translations.literal: Hanlin Academician, Vice Minister of Revenue, and drafter of edicts Cui Yi was made Vice Minister of War, fulfilling duty.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Yi was moved to War vice minister.

sentences.zh: 六月丁亥朔，以京兆尹、嗣薛王知柔兼戶部尚書、判度支，兼諸道鹽鐵轉運等使。

translations.literal: On the first day of the sixth month, dinghai, Jingzhao Intendant and Heir Apparent Prince of Xue Zhirou was made concurrent Minister of Revenue, judged Revenue, and commissioner of salt and iron transport for all circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month dinghai new moon: Prince of Xue Zhirou took Revenue and salt transport.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以太子賓客孔緯為吏部尚書，尋復開府儀同三司、守司空、門下侍郎、同平章事、弘文館大學士、太清宮延資庫使、上柱國、魯郡開國公，食邑四千戶、食實封二百戶，仍號「持危啟運保乂功臣。

translations.literal: On the day renchen Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent Kong Wei was made Minister of Personnel; soon he was again Grand Preceptor of the Palace with the ceremonial of the Three Excellencies, acting Minister of Works, Vice Director of the Chancellery, Associate Grand Councillor, University Fellow of the Hongwen Institute, Commissioner of the Grand Pure Palace and Extended Resources Store, Supreme Pillar of State, Duke of Lu with a fief of four thousand households and two hundred actual enfeoffment households, still styled "Meritorious Minister Who Upholds Crisis, Opens Fortune, and Preserves Order."
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Kong Wei was restored from tutor to Works minister and Duke of Lu, styled Upholds Crisis and Opens Fortune.

sentences.zh: 」時緯在華州，尋屬太原軍至而止。

translations.literal: " At the time Wei was at Hua Prefecture; soon because Taiyuan troops arrived he stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Wei was at Hua when Taiyuan troops came and he halted.

sentences.zh: 以太子賓客張浚復光祿大夫、行兵部尚書、上柱國、河間郡開國侯、食邑二千戶。

translations.literal: Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent Zhang Jun was again Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, acting Minister of War, Supreme Pillar of State, Marquis of Hejian with a fief of two thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun was restored as acting War Minister and Marquis of Hejian.

sentences.zh: 浚在長水，亦不至京師。

translations.literal: Jun was at Changshui and also did not reach the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Jun at Changshui never reached the capital.

sentences.zh: 復以王搏為中書侍郎、平章事。

translations.literal: Wang Bo was again made Vice Director of the Chancellery and Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Bo returned to council.

sentences.zh: 七月丙辰朔，李克用舉軍渡河，以討王行瑜、李茂貞、韓建等稱兵詣闕之罪。

translations.literal: On the first day of the seventh month, bingchen, Li Keyong raised his army, crossed the river, to punish Wang Xingyu, Li Maozhen, Han Jian, and others for raising troops and coming to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month bingchen new moon: Keyong crossed the river to punish the three commanders.

sentences.zh: 庚申，同州節度使王行實棄郡入京師，謂兩軍中尉駱全瓘、劉景宣曰：「沙陀十萬至矣！

translations.literal: On gengshen Tong military commissioner Wang Xingshi abandoned his commandery and entered the capital, telling the two army commandants Luo Quanhong and Liu Jingxuan: "The Shatuo are a hundred thousand strong!
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Wang Xingshi fled to court crying that a hundred thousand Shatuo were coming—

sentences.zh: 請奉車駕幸邠州，且有城守。

translations.literal: Please escort the imperial carriage to Bin Prefecture, and there will also be walls to defend."
translations.idiomatic: begging escort to Binzhou to hold walls."

sentences.zh: 」時景宣附鳳翔，癸亥夜，閻圭與劉景宣子繼晟、同州王行實縱火剽東市，請上出幸。

translations.literal: At the time Jingxuan leaned toward Fengxiang; on the night of guihai Yan Gui with Liu Jingxuan's son Jisheng, Tongzhou Wang Xingshi, set fires and plundered the eastern market, asking the emperor to go out on progress.
translations.idiomatic: Jingxuan favored Fengxiang; that guihai night Yan Gui burned the eastern market and pressed for flight.

sentences.zh: 上聞亂，登承天門，遣諸王率禁兵禦之。

translations.literal: Hearing chaos, the emperor ascended Chengtian Gate and sent the imperial princes to lead guard troops to defend.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaozong mounted Chengtian Gate and sent princes with guards.

sentences.zh: 捧日都頭李筠率本軍侍衛樓上。

translations.literal: Puri company head Li Yun led his army to guard the tower.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yun of Puri guarded the tower.

sentences.zh: 閻圭以鳳翔之卒攻李筠，矢及御座之樓扉。

translations.literal: Yan Gui attacked Li Yun with Fengxiang troops; arrows reached the door panels of the imperial tower.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Gui's Fengxiang arrows struck the tower doors.

sentences.zh: 上懼，下樓與親王、公主、內人數百幸永興坊李筠營。

translations.literal: The emperor was afraid, descended the tower, and with imperial princes, princesses, and several hundred inner persons went in fortune to Li Yun's camp in Yongxing Ward.
translations.idiomatic: Afraid, Zhaozong fled with princes and inner attendants to Li Yun's Yongxing camp.

sentences.zh: 扈蹕都頭李君實以兵繼至，乃與筠兩都兵士侍衛出啟夏門，憩于華嚴寺，以候內人繼至。

translations.literal: Imperial escort company head Li Junshi came afterward with troops; then together with Yun's two companies' soldiers they guarded and went out through Qixia Gate, resting at Huayan Temple to wait for inner persons to follow.
translations.idiomatic: Li Junshi joined Yun; they guarded the emperor out Qixia Gate to Huayan Temple.

sentences.zh: 其日晚，幸莎城鎮。

translations.literal: That evening they reached Shacheng town.
translations.idiomatic: That evening they reached Shacheng.

sentences.zh: 京師士庶從幸者數十萬，比至南山谷口，暍死者三之一。

translations.literal: Gentry and commoners of the capital who followed in fortune numbered several hundred thousand; by the time they reached the southern mountains' valley mouth, one in three died of heatstroke.
translations.idiomatic: Hundreds of thousands followed; one in three died of heat at the mountain pass.

sentences.zh: 至暮，為盜寇掠，慟哭之聲，殷動山谷。

translations.literal: At dusk they were plundered by bandits; the sound of wailing shook the valleys.
translations.idiomatic: At dusk bandits plundered them; wailing filled the valleys.

sentences.zh: 權令京兆尹知柔中書事及隨駕置頓使。

translations.literal: Acting Jingzhao Intendant Zhirou was temporarily ordered to know Secretariat affairs and commissioner for arranging the progress encampment.
translations.idiomatic: Zhirou acted as Secretariat chief and arranged the flight camp.

sentences.zh: 信宿，宰相徐彥若、王摶、崔胤三人至，乃移石門鎮之佛宮。

translations.literal: After two nights chief ministers Xu Yanruo, Wang Bo, and Cui Yin arrived; they then moved to the Buddhist monastery at Shimen town.
translations.idiomatic: Two days later Xu Yanruo, Wang Bo, and Cui Yin came; the court moved to Shimen monastery.

sentences.zh: 仍令知樞密劉光裕、薛王知柔歸京師制置，合禁軍以備宮禁。

translations.literal: They still ordered knowing Palace Secretariat Liu Guangyu and Prince of Xue Zhirou to return to the capital to arrange matters, assembling guard troops to defend the palace.
translations.idiomatic: Guangyu and Zhirou were sent back to organize palace guards.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，李克用遣牙將閻諤奉表奔問，奏屯軍河中，候進止發赴邠州。

translations.literal: On bingyin Li Keyong sent guard officer Yan E to submit a memorial in haste asking after the emperor, memorializing that he encamped his army at Hezhong awaiting orders to advance toward Bin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Keyong's Yan E asked after the emperor and camped at Hezhong awaiting orders to Bin.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，上遣內官張承業傳詔克用軍，便令監太原行營兵馬，發赴新平。

translations.literal: On dingmao the emperor sent inner official Zhang Chengye with an edict to Keyong's army, ordering him at once to supervise Taiyuan encampment troops and advance toward Xinping.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Zhang Chengye ordered Keyong to supervise Taiyuan troops toward Xinping.

sentences.zh: 又令內官郤廷立傳詔涇州，令張鐇起涇原之師會克用軍。

translations.literal: He also sent inner official Xi Tingli with an edict to Jing Prefecture, ordering Zhang Jun to raise Jingyuan troops to join Keyong's army.
translations.idiomatic: Xi Tingli was sent to Jing to raise Jingyuan troops for Keyong.

sentences.zh: 上在南山半月餘，克用仍在河中，未至渭北。

translations.literal: The emperor was in the southern mountains more than half a month; Keyong was still at Hezhong and had not reached north of the Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Half a month in the southern hills, Keyong still lingered at Hezhong.

sentences.zh: 上懼鳳翔兵士劫遷，乃令延王將御服、鞍馬、玉器等至河中，宣諭曰：「朕以景宣、全瓘、行實、繼鵬為表裏之奸謀，縱干戈于雙闕，煙塵倏忽，劫殺縱橫。

translations.literal: The emperor feared Fengxiang troops would seize and move him, and ordered the Prince of Yan to bring imperial dress, saddles, horses, jade vessels, and the like to Hezhong, proclaiming: "We take Jingxuan, Quanhong, Xingshi, and Jipeng as inside-and-outside traitors, who loosed weapons at the twin palaces; smoke and dust came suddenly and slaughter ran wild.
translations.idiomatic: Fearing Fengxiang seizure, he sent the Prince of Yan to Keyong at Hezhong with regalia, saying traitors had stormed the twin palaces—

sentences.zh: 朕偶脫鋒鋩，遂移輦輅，所為巡幸，止在近郊。

translations.literal: We escaped by chance from the blade's edge and moved the carriage; what is called progress is only to the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: he had fled barely alive on a near-suburbs progress.

sentences.zh: 蓋知卿統領雄師，駐臨蒲阪，累飛書詔，繼遣使人。

translations.literal: We know you command a mighty host, stationed at Pubei; edicts flew repeatedly and envoys were sent in succession.
translations.idiomatic: He knew Keyong held Pubei and had sent repeated edicts—

sentences.zh: 期卿以社稷為憂，君親在念，必思回應，速議龔行。

translations.literal: We expected you to take the altars as worry and lord and parent as thought—you must surely think to respond and quickly deliberate the campaign march.
translations.idiomatic: expecting swift march for throne and kin.

sentences.zh: 豈謂將涉兩旬，未有來表，憂虞是切，寢食不遑。

translations.literal: Who would have thought nearly two weeks would pass without a memorial arriving; worry is cutting and sleep and food have no leisure.
translations.idiomatic: Yet two weeks passed without word; he could not eat or sleep.

sentences.zh: 豈忠義不切疚懷，而道途或有阻滯？

translations.literal: Is it that loyalty is not keen in your pained heart, or that on the road there may be obstruction?"
translations.idiomatic: Was loyalty blocked on the road?"

sentences.zh: 今則專令親信，懇托勳賢，故遣延王戒丕、丹王允與供奉官王魯紆等宣示。

translations.literal: Now we specially send trusted kin, earnestly entrusting our meritorious minister, and therefore send the Prince of Yan Jiepi, the Prince of Dan Yun, and attendant official Wang Luyu and others to proclaim this."
translations.idiomatic: He sent Princes Yan and Dan with Wang Luyu to entreat Keyong.

sentences.zh: 卿宜便董貔貅，徑臨邠鳳，蕩平妖穴，以拯阽危，是所望也。

translations.literal: You should at once marshal the tiger guards, go straight to Bin and Feng, sweep the demon lair flat, and rescue peril on the verge—that is what is hoped."
translations.idiomatic: March on Bin and Feng, crush the rebels, and save the throne—that is our hope."
End of the imperial message.

sentences.zh: 八月乙酉朔，延王至河中，克用已發前鋒至渭北，又令史儼率五百騎赴行在侍衛。

translations.literal: On the first day of the eighth month, yiyou, the Prince of Yan reached Hezhong; Keyong had already sent vanguard troops to north of the Wei and also ordered Shi Yan to lead five hundred horse to the progress place to guard.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month yiyou new moon: the Prince of Yan reached Hezhong as Keyong's vanguard crossed the Wei.

sentences.zh: 己丑，克用自至渭橋砦。

translations.literal: On jichou Keyong himself arrived at the Wei Bridge camp.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Keyong reached Wei Bridge.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，行梨園殺邠軍數千，獲其大將王令陶以獻。

translations.literal: On guisi the Pear Garden performers killed several thousand Bin troops and captured their great commander Wang Lingtao to present.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Pear Garden men killed thousands of Bin troops and took Wang Lingtao.

sentences.zh: 又詔鄜州節度使李思孝本軍進討。

translations.literal: An edict also ordered Bin military commissioner Li Sixiao to lead his army on campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Li Sixiao of Bin was ordered to campaign.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，制以河東節度使、開府儀同三司、守太師、中書令，兼太原尹、北都留守、上柱國、隴西郡王李克用為邠寧四面行營都招討使。

translations.literal: On dingyou an edict made Hedong military commissioner, Grand Preceptor of the Palace with the ceremonial of the Three Excellencies, acting Grand Preceptor, Director of the Secretariat, concurrent Governor of Taiyuan, Northern Capital regent, Supreme Pillar of State, Prince of Longxi Li Keyong overall suppression commissioner on four sides of Binning.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Keyong was made overall suppression commissioner of Binning.

sentences.zh: 夏州節度使李思諫充邠甯東北面招討使，涇原節度使張鐇充邠甯西面招討使，河中節度使王珂充行營供軍糧料使。

translations.literal: Xia military commissioner Li Sixian was made northeastern suppression commissioner of Binning, Jingyuan military commissioner Zhang Jun was made western suppression commissioner of Binning, and Hezhong military commissioner Wang Ke was made encampment grain supply commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Li Sixian, Zhang Jun, and Wang Ke were made Binning sub-commissioners and supply chief.

sentences.zh: 李茂貞聞之懼，斬閻圭、武禿子，傳首行在，上章請罪。

translations.literal: Li Maozhen heard and was afraid; he beheaded Yan Gui and the bald warrior, sent their heads to the progress place, and submitted a memorial asking punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Maozhen, afraid, beheaded Yan Gui and sent heads to the emperor's camp pleading guilt.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，制削奪王行瑜在身官爵。

translations.literal: On xinchou an edict stripped Wang Xingyu of all personal offices and titles.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Xingyu was stripped of all titles.

sentences.zh: 改授李克用邠寧四面行營都統。

translations.literal: Li Keyong was reassigned as overall commander of the encircling armies on four sides of Binning.
translations.idiomatic: Keyong was made overall Binning commander.

sentences.zh: 其大將蓋寓李存信閻鍔、判官王讓李襲吉等，並降詔錫賚。

translations.literal: His great generals Gai Yu, Li Cunxin, Yan E, and aides Wang Rang, Li Xiji, and others all received edicts with gifts.
translations.idiomatic: Gai Yu, Cunxin, Yan E, Wang Rang, and Li Xiji received reward edicts.

sentences.zh: 又以河中都監袁季貞充邠寧四面行營兵馬都監押。

translations.literal: Hezhong overseer Yuan Jizhen was also made overall military overseer and controller of the encircling armies on four sides of Binning.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Jizhen of Hezhong was made army overseer of the Binning campaign.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，李克用遣子存貞奉表行在，請車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On renyin Li Keyong sent his son Cunzhen to submit a memorial at the progress place, asking that the imperial carriage return to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Cunzhen asked the emperor to return to the palace.

sentences.zh: 答詔曰：「昨延王回，言卿憂時體國，執禮輸忠，接遇之間，周旋盡節。

translations.literal: The reply edict said: "Yesterday the Prince of Yan returned, saying you worry for the age and embody the state, hold rites and offer loyalty—in meeting, every turn was full of propriety.
translations.idiomatic: The reply said: "The Prince of Yan reports your loyalty and propriety—

sentences.zh: 備知肺腑，識我恩榮，靜惟尊主之心，果契知臣之分。

translations.literal: We know your inmost heart and recognize our grace and glory; quietly considering your heart to honor the lord, it truly matches the minister's part.
translations.idiomatic: we know your heart honors the throne.

sentences.zh: 朕欲取今月十二四日卻復都城，冀寧兆庶，倚我勳德，有若長城，速伸翦蕩之謀，以慰黔黎之望。

translations.literal: We wish to return to the capital on the twelfth or fourteenth of this month, hoping to settle the myriad people, relying on your merit and virtue like the Long Wall—quickly extend the plan to cut down and settle, to comfort the black-headed people's hope."
translations.idiomatic: We wish to return on the twelfth or fourteenth, relying on you like a Long Wall—strike quickly."

sentences.zh: 」癸卯，又令延王傳詔，令克用發騎軍三千赴三橋屯駐，以備回鑾。

translations.literal: On guimao he again ordered the Prince of Yan to transmit an edict ordering Keyong to send three thousand cavalry to garrison at Sanqiao to prepare for the return progress.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao three thousand horse were ordered to Sanqiao for the return.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On xinhai the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai the emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 壬子，司空、門下侍郎、平章事、臨修國史、諸道鹽鐵轉運使崔昭緯罷知政事，為太子賓客。

translations.literal: On renzi Minister of Works, Vice Director of the Chancellery, Grand Councillor, supervisor of the national history, and commissioner of salt and iron transport for all circuits Cui Zhaowei ceased knowing government affairs and was made Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Cui Zhaowei left council and became Junior Tutor.

sentences.zh: 以河中兵馬留後王珂檢校司空，兼河中尹、御史大夫，充護國軍節度、河中晉絳慈隰觀察等使；

translations.literal: Hezhong acting military commissioner Wang Ke was made acting Minister of Works, concurrent Hezhong governor and Censor-in-Chief, and military commissioner of Huguo with Hezhong-Jin-Jiang-Ci-Wei observation;
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ke was made Huguo commissioner at Hezhong;

sentences.zh: 以幽州兵馬留後劉仁恭檢校司空，兼幽州大都督府長史，充幽州盧龍軍節度、押奚契丹等使；

translations.literal: You acting military commissioner Liu Rengong was made acting Minister of Works, concurrent Grand Governor of You Prefecture, and military commissioner of Lulong with charge over the Xi and Khitan;
translations.idiomatic: Liu Rengong was made Lulong commissioner at You;

sentences.zh: 以故左軍中尉楊復恭開府、魏國公：並從克用奏請也。

translations.literal: the late Left Army Commander Yang Fugong was made Grand Preceptor of the Palace and Duke of Wei—all followed Keyong's memorial requests.
translations.idiomatic: and the dead Yang Fugong was posthumously made Grand Preceptor and Duke of Wei—all at Keyong's request.

sentences.zh: 九月甲寅朔。

translations.literal: On the first day of the ninth month, jiayin, the new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month opened on jiayin.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，制光祿大夫、守尚書左僕射、門下侍郎、同平章事、監修國史、上柱國、東莞郡公徐彥若為司空、門下侍郎、同平章事、太清宮修奉太廟等使、弘文館大學士、延資庫使，充諸道鹽鐵轉運等使。

translations.literal: On bingchen an edict made Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, acting Left Vice Director of the Secretariat, Vice Director of the Chancellery, Associate Grand Councillor, supervisor of the national history, Supreme Pillar of State, Duke of Dongguan Xu Yanruo Minister of Works, Vice Director of the Chancellery, Associate Grand Councillor, commissioner for repair of the Grand Pure Palace and maintenance of the ancestral temple and other duties, University Fellow of the Hongwen Institute, Commissioner of the Extended Resources Store, and commissioner of salt and iron transport for all circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Xu Yanruo took Works, temple duties, and salt transport.

sentences.zh: 正議大夫、中書侍郎、同平章事王摶為金紫光祿大夫、戶部尚書門下侍郎、監修國史、判度支；

translations.literal: Proper Counselor Vice Director of the Chancellery and Associate Grand Councillor Wang Bo was made Grand Master of Golden Purple Splendor, Minister of Revenue, Vice Director of the Chancellery, supervisor of the national history, and judge of Revenue;
translations.idiomatic: Wang Bo took Golden Purple rank, Revenue, and history;

sentences.zh: 正議大夫、中書侍郎、同平章事崔胤為金紫光祿大夫、戶部兼禮部尚書、集賢殿大學士、判戶部事。

translations.literal: Proper Counselor Vice Director of the Chancellery and Associate Grand Councillor Cui Yin was made Grand Master of Golden Purple Splendor, concurrent Minister of Revenue and Rites, University Fellow of the Jixian Hall, and judge of Revenue affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Yin took Golden Purple rank, Revenue and Rites, and Jixian;

sentences.zh: 並賜號「扶危匡國致理功臣。

translations.literal: All were granted the title "Meritorious Minister Who Supports Crisis, Rights the State, and Brings Order."
translations.idiomatic: all titled Supports Crisis and Rights the State.

sentences.zh: 」癸亥，司空、門下侍郎、平章事、太清宮修奉太廟等使、弘文館大學士、延資庫使、上柱國、魯郡開國公孔緯卒，贈太尉。

translations.literal: On guihai Minister of Works, Vice Director of the Chancellery, Grand Councillor, commissioner for repair of the Grand Pure Palace and maintenance of the ancestral temple and other duties, University Fellow of the Hongwen Institute, Commissioner of the Extended Resources Store, Supreme Pillar of State, Duke of Lu Kong Wei died; he was posthumously made Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Kong Wei died; posthumous Grand Commandant.

sentences.zh: 十月甲申朔，王師破賊梨園砦，俘斬萬計，行瑜由是嬰城自固。

translations.literal: On the first day of the tenth month, jiashen, the imperial army broke the rebel Pear Garden camp, capturing and beheading tens of thousands; Xingyu thereupon held his walls and firmly defended himself.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month jiashen new moon: the imperial army broke the Pear Garden camp; tens of thousands fell; Xingyu held his walls.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，制赦系囚，其節文曰：「其有任崇柱石，位重台衡，或委以軍權，或參諸宥密。

translations.literal: On dinghai, an edict pardoned prisoners in bonds; the text read: "Those who held lofty rank as pillar and stone, whose posts weighed as Grand Councilor, or were entrusted with military authority, or took part in secret councils.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai an amnesty edict freed bound prisoners; it read: "Those who stood as pillars of state, weighed as Grand Councilors, held military power, or sat in secret councils—

sentences.zh: 竟因連謗，終至禍名，鬱我好生，嗟乎強死。

translations.literal: Yet through successive slander they came at last to a name of disaster; thwarting my love of life—alas, forced to die.
translations.idiomatic: yet through successive slander they met disaster; thwarting my love of life—alas, they were forced to die.

sentences.zh: 應大順已來，有非罪而加削奪者，並復官資。

translations.literal: From Dashun onward, all who suffered disgrace and divestiture for no crime shall have office and salary restored.
translations.idiomatic: From Dashun on, all stripped of rank without crime shall have office and salary restored.

sentences.zh: 其杜讓能、西門君遂、李周潼已下，並與昭雪，還其爵秩。

translations.literal: Du Rangneng, Ximen Junsui, Li Zhoutong, and those below—all shall be cleared, with rank and titles returned.
translations.idiomatic: Du Rangneng, Ximen Junsui, Li Zhoutong, and those below are cleared and their ranks restored.

sentences.zh: 韋昭度頃處台司，每伸相業，王行瑜求尚書令，獨能抑之，致於沉冤，諒由此事。

translations.literal: Wei Zhaodu once held the Secretariat and repeatedly advanced the chancellor's work; when Wang Xingyu sought the office of Director of the Department of State Affairs, he alone could suppress it—leading to his deep wrong; surely it was for this.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Zhaodu once headed the Secretariat and repeatedly advanced policy; he alone blocked Wang Xingyu's bid for Director of the Department of State Affairs—and was ruined for it.

sentences.zh: 李磎文章宏贍，迥出輩流，竟以朋黨之間，擠於死地，凡在有識，孰不咨嗟。

translations.literal: Li Mo's writings were grand and ample, far above his peers; yet amid factional strife he was squeezed to death—in all who had understanding, who did not sigh?
translations.idiomatic: Li Mo wrote with grand eloquence, far above his peers; yet faction drove him to his death, and all who knew it sighed.

sentences.zh: 宜並與昭洗，仍復官爵。

translations.literal: They should all be cleared and washed, with office and titles restored.
translations.idiomatic: They are all to be cleared and their offices and titles restored.

sentences.zh: 」又敕：「太子賓客崔昭緯責授梧州司馬，水部郎中、知制誥劉崇魯貶崖州司戶。

translations.literal: " Another edict: Crown Prince Mentor Cui Zhaowei was demoted to Taizhou Registrar; Waterways Bureau Director and Drafting Officer Liu Chonglu was banished to Yazhou Registrar.
translations.idiomatic: " Another edict demoted Crown Prince Mentor Cui Zhaowei to Taizhou registrar and banished drafting officer Liu Chonglu to Yazhou registrar.

sentences.zh: 又詔邠州行營都統曰：「邠州節度副使崔鋋，破賊之時，勿令漏網。

translations.literal: Another edict to the Binzhou campaign commander-in-chief: "When Vice Commissioner Cui Yin of Binzhou breaks the rebels, let none escape the net."
translations.idiomatic: Another edict to the Binzhou campaign commander: "When Vice Commissioner Cui Yin breaks the rebels, let none escape."

sentences.zh: 鋋與昭緯去年朋黨，交結行瑜，構合禍胎，原由此賊。

translations.literal: Yin and Zhaowei were faction allies last year, joined with Xingyu, and wove the womb of disaster—the root lies in this villain.
translations.idiomatic: Yin and Zhaowei were allies last year, joined Xingyu, and wove this disaster—the root is this villain.

sentences.zh: 付四面行營知委。

translations.literal: He was entrusted to the four-sided campaign staffs for their disposition.
translations.idiomatic: He was entrusted to the four-sided campaign staffs.

sentences.zh: 」是月，四面行營大集邠州。

translations.literal: " That month the four-sided campaign armies massed at Binzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month all four campaign armies massed at Binzhou.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸未朔。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on guimao, the first day of the month.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, guimao—the new moon.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，王行瑜與其妻子部曲五百餘人潰圍出奔，至慶州，行瑜為部下所殺，並其家二百口，並詣行營乞降，李克用遣牙將閻鍔獻于京師。

translations.literal: On renyin, Wang Xingyu with his wife, children, and retainers—more than five hundred—broke the encirclement and fled; reaching Qingzhou, Xingyu was killed by his subordinates, and his household of two hundred with them came to the campaign camp to surrender; Li Keyong sent his牙 officer Yan E to present them at the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Wang Xingyu fled the siege with wife, children, and five hundred retainers; at Qingzhou his men killed him; two hundred of his household surrendered; Li Keyong sent Yan E to present them at court.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲申朔，昭宗御延喜門受俘馘，百僚樓前稱賀。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on jiashen, the first day, Zhaozong received captives and heads at the Yanxi Gate; the hundred officials hailed victory before the tower.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, jiashen new moon: Zhaozong received captives at Yanxi Gate; officials hailed victory below the tower.

sentences.zh: 制以李克用守太師、中書令，進封晉王，食邑九千戶，改賜「忠貞平難功臣。

translations.literal: An edict made Li Keyong Guardian Grand Preceptor and Director of the Secretariat, advanced to Prince of Jin, fief of nine thousand households, and granted the title "Loyal and True Pacifier of Disturbances."
translations.idiomatic: An edict made Li Keyong Grand Preceptor and Director of the Secretariat, Prince of Jin with nine thousand households, titled Loyal and True Pacifier of Disturbances.

sentences.zh: 」是月，克用班師太原。

translations.literal: " That month Keyong led his army back to Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: That month Keyong withdrew to Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 制：皇第三子祤封棣王，第五子禊封虔王，第六子禋封沂王，第七子禕封遂王。

translations.literal: Edict: the third imperial son Qi was enfeoffed Prince of Di, the fifth son Xi Prince of Qian, the sixth Yin Prince of Yi, the seventh Yi Prince of Sui.
translations.idiomatic: Edict: the third son Qi became Prince of Di; the fifth Xi, Prince of Qian; the sixth Yin, Prince of Yi; the seventh Yi, Prince of Sui.

sentences.zh: 乾寧三年三年春正月癸丑朔，制以特進、戶部尚書、兼京兆尹、嗣薛王知柔檢校司徒，兼廣州刺史、御史大夫，充清海軍節度、嶺南東道觀察處置等使。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month, on guichou, the first day of the third year of Qianning, an edict made Special Advancement Holder, Minister of Revenue, concurrent Jingzhao Magistrate, and Heir of the Prince of Xue Zhirou Acting Minister of Works, concurrent Guangzhou Prefect and Censor-in-Chief, and Military Commissioner of Qinghai and Commissioner of Lingnan East Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Qianning 3, spring, guichou new moon: Zhirou, Heir of Xue, Minister of Revenue and Jingzhao Magistrate, was made Acting Minister of Works, Guangzhou prefect, and Qinghai–Lingnan East commissioner.

sentences.zh: 以尚書右丞崔澤為鳳州刺史。

translations.literal: Right Assistant Censor Cui Ze was made Prefect of Fengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Right Assistant Censor Cui Ze became prefect of Fengzhou.

sentences.zh: 魏博羅弘信擊敗太原軍於莘縣。

translations.literal: Luo Hongxin of Weibo defeated the Taiyuan army at Shen County.
translations.idiomatic: Weibo's Luo Hongxin defeated the Taiyuan army at Shen County.

sentences.zh: 初，兗鄆示援於太原，克用令蕃將史完府、何懷寶等千騎赴之。

translations.literal: At first Yan and Yun had shown support for Taiyuan; Keyong sent his tribal generals Shi Wanfu and He Huaibao with a thousand horsemen to aid them.
translations.idiomatic: Yan and Yun had sought Taiyuan's aid; Keyong sent tribal generals Shi Wanfu and He Huaibao with a thousand horsemen.

sentences.zh: 至是又令大將李存信屯於莘縣，魏人常假其道，存信戢軍不謹，或侵撓魏民。

translations.literal: Now he again ordered Grand General Li Cunxin to camp at Shen County; the Wei people often lent passage, but Cunxin disciplined his troops poorly and sometimes harassed Wei civilians.
translations.idiomatic: He now sent Li Cunxin to camp at Shen; the Wei often lent passage, but Cunxin disciplined poorly and harassed Wei civilians.

sentences.zh: 弘信怒，伏兵擊之，其軍宵潰。

translations.literal: Hongxin was enraged and ambushed them; the army fled in rout that night.
translations.idiomatic: Hongxin ambushed them; the army routed that night.

sentences.zh: 自是弘信南結于梁，與太原絕，兗鄆已至俱陷。

translations.literal: From then on Hongxin allied south with Liang and broke with Taiyuan; Yan and Yun had by then both fallen.
translations.idiomatic: Hongxin then allied with Liang and broke with Taiyuan; Yan and Yun had both fallen.

sentences.zh: 二月壬子朔，制以通王滋為開府儀同三司，判侍衛諸道軍事。

translations.literal: In the second month, on renzi, the first day, an edict made Prince of Tong Zi Grand Master of Honor with Golden Seal and Acting Commander of the Palace Guards for All Circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, renzi new moon: Prince of Tong Zi was made Grand Master of Honor and acting commander of palace guards for all circuits.

sentences.zh: 以銀青光祿大夫、戶部尚書、嘉興縣子、食邑五百戶陸扆為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Silver-Gleam Grandee Lu Yi, Minister of Revenue, Baron of Jiaxing with five hundred households, was made Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Yi, Silver-Gleam Grandee and Minister of Revenue, Baron of Jiaxing, became Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 三月壬子朔，以考功員外郎、集賢殿學士杜德祥為工部郎中、知制誥。

translations.literal: In the third month, on renzi, the first day, Examination Bureau Outer Director and Hall Scholar Du Dexiang was made Director of the Works Bureau and Drafting Officer.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, renzi new moon: Du Dexiang, examination outer director and hall scholar, became Works Bureau director and drafting officer.

sentences.zh: 四月壬午朔，湖南軍亂，殺其帥劉建鋒，三軍立其部將權知邵州刺史馬殷為兵馬留後。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, on renwu, the first day, Hunan troops mutinied, killed their commander Liu Jianfeng, and the three armies installed his subordinate, acting Shaozhou prefect Ma Yin, as military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, renwu new moon: Hunan troops killed Liu Jianfeng; the armies made his subordinate Ma Yin, acting Shaozhou prefect, military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 鎮海軍節度使錢鏐攻越州，下之，斬董昌，平浙東。

translations.literal: Qian Liu, military commissioner of Zhenhai, attacked Yuezhou, took it, beheaded Dong Chang, and pacified eastern Zhe.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenhai commissioner Qian Liu took Yuezhou, beheaded Dong Chang, and pacified eastern Zhe.

sentences.zh: 制加錢鏐檢校太尉、中書令。

translations.literal: An edict advanced Qian Liu to Acting Grand Guardian and Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Qian Liu was advanced to acting grand guardian and director of the secretariat.

sentences.zh: 五月辛巳，責授梧州司馬崔昭緯賜自盡。

translations.literal: On xinsi, demoted Taizhou Registrar Cui Zhaowei was ordered to take his own life.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi demoted registrar Cui Zhaowei was ordered to kill himself.

sentences.zh: 制金紫光祿大夫、戶部尚書、門下侍郎、平章事、監修國史、上柱國、太原郡開國公王摶為檢校尚書左僕射、同平章事，兼越州刺史，充鎮東軍節度、浙江東道觀察處置等使。

translations.literal: An edict made Golden-Gleam Grandee Wang Tuan, Minister of Revenue, Vice Director of the Secretariat, Grand Councilor, Commissioner for Editing the National History, Supreme Pillar of State, Duke of Taiyuan, Acting Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Grand Councilor, concurrent Yuezhou Prefect, and Military Commissioner of Zhendong and Commissioner of Zhe East Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Tuan, golden-gleam grandee and grand councilor, was made acting left vice director, Yuezhou prefect, and Zhendong–Zhe East commissioner.

sentences.zh: 六月庚戌，李克用率沙陀、並、汾之眾五萬攻魏州，及其郛，大掠於其六郡，陷成安、洹水、臨漳十餘邑，報莘之怨也。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Li Keyong led fifty thousand Shatuo and Bing-Fen troops to attack Weizhou and its outer wall, plundering greatly through six prefectures, taking more than ten districts including Cheng'an, Huanshui, and Linzhang—avenging Shen.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Keyong led fifty thousand Shatuo and Bing-Fen troops against Weizhou, ravaging six prefectures and more than ten districts—a reprisal for Shen.

sentences.zh: 鳳翔李茂貞怨國家有朱玫之討，絕朝貢，謀將犯闕，天子命覃王治兵以俟變。

translations.literal: Li Maozhen of Fengxiang resented the court's campaign against Zhu Mei, broke off tribute, and plotted to strike the capital; the Son of Heaven ordered Prince of Tan to ready troops against change.
translations.idiomatic: Maozhen of Fengxiang, resenting the Zhu Mei campaign, stopped tribute and plotted against the capital; the emperor ordered Prince of Tan to ready troops.

sentences.zh: 是月，茂貞上章，請以兵師入覲。

translations.literal: That month Maozhen submitted a memorial asking to bring troops to audience.
translations.idiomatic: That month Maozhen asked leave to bring troops to audience.

sentences.zh: 上令通王、覃王、延王分統安聖、捧宸、保寧、宣化等四軍，以衛近畿。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Princes of Tong, Tan, and Yan each to command the Ansheng, Pongchen, Baoning, and Xuanhua armies to guard the near capital.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Princes of Tong, Tan, and Yan to command Ansheng, Pongchen, Baoning, and Xuanhua armies for the capital approaches.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，鳳翔軍犯京畿，覃王拒之于婁館，接戰不利。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Fengxiang troops struck the capital region; Prince of Tan met them at Lou Lodge and fought to disadvantage.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Fengxiang troops struck the capital approaches; Prince of Tan met them at Lou Lodge and lost.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚辰朔。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on gengchen, the first day of autumn.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, gengchen—autumn's new moon.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，岐軍逼京師，諸王率禁兵奉車駕將幸太原。

translations.literal: On renchen, Qi troops pressed the capital; the princes led palace troops to escort the imperial carriage toward Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Qi troops pressed the capital; princes led palace troops to escort the emperor toward Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，次渭北，華州韓建遣子充奉表起居，請駐蹕華州，乃授建京畿都指揮、安撫制置、催促諸道綱運等使。

translations.literal: On guisi the court halted north of the Wei; Han Jian of Huazhou sent his son Chong with a memorial of greeting, asking the emperor to halt at Huazhou; Jian was then made Capital Region Commander, Pacification Commissioner, and Commissioner to Urge Tribute Transport from All Circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi the court halted north of the Wei; Han Jian of Huazhou begged a halt at Huazhou and was made capital-region commander and tribute-transport commissioner.

sentences.zh: 詔謂建曰：「啟途之行，已在河東，今且幸鄜畤。

translations.literal: An edict told Jian: "The journey already begun lies in Hedong; for now we shall visit Zhiyu."
translations.idiomatic: The edict told Jian: "The journey to Hedong is begun; for now we visit Zhiyu."

sentences.zh: 」甲午，次富平。

translations.literal: " On jiawu the court reached Fuping.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the court reached Fuping.

sentences.zh: 韓建來朝，泣奏曰：「籓臣倔強，非止茂貞。

translations.literal: Han Jian came to audience, weeping as he memorialized: "The feudatories are stubborn—not Maozhen alone.
translations.idiomatic: Han Jian came to audience weeping: "The feudatories are stubborn—not Maozhen alone.

sentences.zh: 雖太原勤王，無宜巡幸。

translations.literal: Though Taiyuan aids the throne, the imperial progress should not visit there.
translations.idiomatic: Though Taiyuan aids the throne, the emperor should not go there.

sentences.zh: 臣之鎮守，控扼關畿，兵力雖微，足以自固。

translations.literal: My commandery guards the passes; though my forces are slight, they suffice to hold firm.
translations.idiomatic: My commandery guards the passes; though slight, my forces can hold.

sentences.zh: 陛下若輕舍近畿，遠巡極塞，去園陵宗廟，寧不痛心，失魏闕金湯，又非良算。

translations.literal: If Your Majesty lightly leaves the near capital for the far frontier, leaving ancestral tombs and temples—will you not grieve? To lose the Wei capital's golden ramparts is no good plan.
translations.idiomatic: To leave the near capital for the far frontier, abandoning tombs and the golden ramparts of Wei—what grief, and what folly.

sentences.zh: 若輿駕渡河，必難再復，謀苟不臧，悔之寧及。

translations.literal: If the carriage crosses the river, return will be hard; if the plan fails, regret will come too late.
translations.idiomatic: Cross the river and return will be hard; a bad plan brings regret too late.

sentences.zh: 願陛下且駐三峰，以圖恢復。

translations.literal: I beg Your Majesty to halt at Sanfeng for now and plan recovery.
translations.idiomatic: Beg Your Majesty halt at Sanfeng and plan recovery.

sentences.zh: 」上亦泣下曰：「朕難奈茂貞，忿不思難。

translations.literal: " The emperor too wept and said: "I cannot bear Maozhen's pressure and in anger did not think of hardship.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wept: "I cannot bear Maozhen's pressure and in anger forgot hardship.

sentences.zh: 卿言是也。

translations.literal: Your words are right."
translations.idiomatic: You speak rightly."

sentences.zh: 」乙未，次下邽丙申，駐蹕華州，以衙城為行宮。

translations.literal: " On yiwei the court reached Xiaji; on bingchen it halted at Huazhou, taking the yamen city as the traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei the court reached Xiaji; on bingchen it halted at Huazhou, the yamen city as traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 時岐軍犯京師，宮室廛閭，鞠為灰燼，自中和已來葺構之功，掃地盡矣。

translations.literal: At that time Qi troops had struck the capital; palaces and lanes were reduced to ash—all the rebuilding since Zhonghe was swept away.
translations.idiomatic: Qi troops had struck the capital; palaces and lanes were ash—all rebuilding since Zhonghe was gone.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，制以金紫光祿大夫、中書侍郎，兼禮部尚書、同平章事、集賢殿大學士、判戶部事、上柱國、博陵縣開國伯崔胤檢校尚書左僕射，兼廣州刺史、御史大夫，充清海軍節度、嶺南東道觀察處置等使。

translations.literal: On yisi, an edict made Golden-Gleam Grandee Cui Yin, Vice Director of the Secretariat, concurrent Minister of Rites and Grand Councilor, Grand Scholar of the Hall of Assembled Worthies, Controller of Revenue, Supreme Pillar, Baron of Boling, Acting Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, concurrent Guangzhou Prefect and Censor-in-Chief, and Military Commissioner of Qinghai and Commissioner of Lingnan East Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Cui Yin, golden-gleam grandee and grand councilor, was made acting left vice director, Guangzhou prefect, and Qinghai–Lingnan East commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丙午，制以翰林學士承旨、尚書左丞、知制誥、嘉興縣開國子、食邑五百戶陸扆為戶部侍郎、同平章事。

translations.literal: On bingwu, an edict made Hanlin Academician-in-Chief Lu Yi, Left Assistant Censor, Drafting Officer, Baron of Jiaxing with five hundred households, Vice Minister of Revenue and Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Lu Yi, hanlin chief and drafting officer, became vice minister of revenue and grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 八月己酉朔。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on jiyou, the first day.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, jiyou new moon.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，新除鎮東軍節度使錢鏐權領浙江東道軍州事。

translations.literal: On jiayin, the newly appointed Zhendong commissioner Qian Liu was authorized to lead Zhe East military and prefectural affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin newly appointed Zhendong commissioner Qian Liu was authorized to lead Zhe East affairs.

sentences.zh: 戊午，制以戶部侍郎、平章事陸扆為中書侍郎，兼判戶部事。

translations.literal: On wuwu, an edict made Grand Councilor Lu Yi, Vice Minister of Revenue, Vice Director of the Secretariat, and Controller of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Lu Yi became vice director of the secretariat and controller of revenue.

sentences.zh: 九月己卯朔，汴州朱全忠、河南尹張全義與關東諸侯俱上表，言秦中有災，請車駕遷都洛陽。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on jimao, the first day, Zhu Quanzhong of Bianzhou, Zhang Quanyi, Henan Magistrate, and the eastern feudatories all memorialized that Qin had disaster and begged the imperial carriage move the capital to Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, jimao new moon: Quanzhong, Quanyi, and eastern lords said Qin had disaster and begged removal to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 全忠、全義言臣已表率諸籓，繕治洛陽宮室。

translations.literal: Quanzhong and Quanyi said they had already led the feudatories in repairing Luoyang's palaces.
translations.idiomatic: Quanzhong and Quanyi said they had led feudatories in repairing Luoyang's palaces.

sentences.zh: 優詔答之。

translations.literal: A gracious edict answered them.
translations.idiomatic: The throne answered graciously.

sentences.zh: 乙未，制新除清海軍節度使崔胤復知政事。

translations.literal: On yiwei, an edict restored the newly appointed Qinghai commissioner Cui Yin to government affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei newly appointed Qinghai commissioner Cui Yin was restored to government.

sentences.zh: 胤之出鎮，朱全忠再表請論奏，言胤不宜去相位，故有是命。

translations.literal: When Yin left for his command, Zhu Quanzhong twice memorialized that Yin should not leave the chancellorship; hence this order.
translations.idiomatic: When Yin went out, Quanzhong twice begged he keep the chancellorship—hence the order.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，制中書侍郎、集賢殿大學士、判戶部事陸扆責授硤州刺史，崔胤怒扆代己，誣奏扆黨庇茂貞故也。

translations.literal: On dingyou, an edict demoted Vice Director of the Secretariat Lu Yi to Prefect of Xiazhou—Yin hated Yi for replacing him and slandered him as Maozhen's partisan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Lu Yi was demoted to Xiazhou—Yin hated him for replacing him and slandered him as Maozhen's partisan.

sentences.zh: 丙午，制以鎮國軍節度使韓建檢校太尉，兼中書令，充修復宮闕、京畿制置、催促諸道綱運等使。

translations.literal: On bingwu, an edict made Zhenguo commissioner Han Jian Acting Grand Guardian, concurrent Director of the Secretariat, Commissioner to Restore the Palaces, Capital Region Commissioner, and Commissioner to Urge Tribute Transport.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Han Jian was made acting grand guardian, director of the secretariat, and palace-restoration commissioner.

sentences.zh: 以京兆尹孫偓為兵部侍郎、同平章事。

translations.literal: Jingzhao Magistrate Sun Wo was made Vice Minister of War and Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: Jingzhao Magistrate Sun Wo became vice minister of war and grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 十月戊申朔，以中書舍人、權知禮部貢舉薛昭緯為禮部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, on wushen, the first day, Secretariat Draftsman Xue Zhaowei, acting Director of the Ministry of Rites for the examinations, was made Vice Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, wushen new moon: Xue Zhaowei became vice minister of rites.

sentences.zh: 壬子，制以兵部侍郎、平章事孫偓為中書侍郎，充鳳翔行營招討使。

translations.literal: On renzi, an edict made Grand Councilor Sun Wo, Vice Minister of War, Vice Director of the Secretariat, and Pacification Commissioner for the Fengxiang campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Sun Wo became vice director of the secretariat and Fengxiang pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，偓於驛舍會諸將，以議進軍。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Wo met the generals at the relay station to discuss advancing.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Wo met generals at the relay station to discuss advancing.

sentences.zh: 戊午，李茂貞上表章請罪，願改事君之禮，繼修職貢，仍獻錢十五萬，助修京闕。

translations.literal: On wuwu, Li Maozhen submitted a memorial begging pardon, vowing to reform his service to the ruler and resume tribute, and presented one hundred fifty thousand cash to aid palace repair.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Maozhen begged pardon, vowed renewed service and tribute, and gave one hundred fifty thousand cash for palace repair.

sentences.zh: 韓建左右之，師遂不行。

translations.literal: Han Jian swayed the emperor; the army was not sent.
translations.idiomatic: Han Jian swayed him; no army marched.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁丑朔，以韓建兼領京兆尹、京城把截使。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on dingchou, the first day, Han Jian was also made concurrent Jingzhao Magistrate and Capital Gate Controller.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, dingchou new moon: Han Jian also became Jingzhao magistrate and capital gate controller.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁未，李克用縱兵俘剽魏博諸郡邑。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Li Keyong's troops captured and plundered Weibo's districts and towns.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Keyong's troops captured and plundered Weibo districts.

sentences.zh: 以前翰林學士承旨、尚書左丞、知制誥趙光遠為御史中丞。

translations.literal: Former Hanlin Academician-in-Chief Zhao Guangyuan, Left Assistant Censor and Drafting Officer, was made Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Former hanlin chief Zhao Guangyuan became vice censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 太常禮院奏權立行廟，以備告饗，從之。

translations.literal: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices memorialized establishing a traveling temple for offerings; the edict was assented to.
translations.idiomatic: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices asked to establish a traveling temple for offerings; the edict was assented to.

sentences.zh: 乾寧四年四年春正月丁丑朔，車駕在華州行宮，受群臣朝賀。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month, on dingchou, the first day of the fourth year of Qianning, the imperial carriage was at the Huazhou traveling palace and received the hundred officials in audience.
translations.idiomatic: Qianning 4, spring, dingchou new moon: the emperor at Huazhou traveling palace received officials in audience.

sentences.zh: 癸未，汴將龐師古陷鄆州，節度使朱瑄與妻榮氏潰圍，瑄至中都，為野人所殺，榮氏俘於汴軍。

translations.literal: On guimao, Bian general Pang Shigu took Yanzhou; Commissioner Zhu Xuan broke the siege with his wife Lady Rong; Xuan reached Zhongdu and was killed by villagers; Lady Rong was captured by Bian troops.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Pang Shigu took Yanzhou; Zhu Xuan fled with Lady Rong, was killed at Zhongdu; she was captured.

sentences.zh: 朱全忠署龐師古為鄆州兵馬留後。

translations.literal: Zhu Quanzhong appointed Pang Shigu acting Yanzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Quanzhong appointed Pang Shigu acting Yanzhou commissioner.

sentences.zh: 宰相孫偓罷知政事，守兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Grand Councilor Sun Wo left government affairs and kept the post of Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Councilor Sun Wo left government and kept the ministry of war.

sentences.zh: 二月丙午朔。

translations.literal: In the second month, on bingwu, the first day.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, bingwu new moon.

sentences.zh: 戊申，汴將葛從周攻兗州，陷之，節度使朱瑾奔楊行密，其將康懷貞降從周，朱全忠署從周為兗州兵馬留後。

translations.literal: On wushen, Bian general Ge Congzhou attacked Yanzhou, took it; Commissioner Zhu Jin fled to Yang Xingmi; his general Kang Huai Zhen surrendered to Congzhou; Quanzhong appointed Congzhou acting Yanzhou commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Ge Congzhou took Yanzhou; Zhu Jin fled to Yang Xingmi; Kang Huai Zhen surrendered; Quanzhong made Congzhou acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 自是鄆、齊、曹、棣、兗、沂、密、徐、宿、陳、許、鄭、滑、濮等州皆沒于全忠，唯王師範守青州，亦納款於汴。

translations.literal: From then Yan, Qi, Cao, Di, Yan, Yi, Mi, Xu, Su, Chen, Xu, Zheng, Hua, and Pu all fell to Quanzhong; only Wang Shifan held Qingzhou and also submitted to Bian.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter Yan, Qi, Cao, Di, Yan, Yi, Mi, Xu, Su, Chen, Xu, Zheng, Hua, and Pu fell to Quanzhong; only Shifan held Qingzhou and also submitted.

sentences.zh: 己未，制朝議大夫、守右散騎常侍、上柱國、滎陽縣男鄭綮為禮部侍郎、同平章事。

translations.literal: An edict made Court Gentleman for Consultation Zheng Qi, Right Regular Attendant, Supreme Pillar, Baron of Xingyang, Vice Minister of Rites and Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: An edict made Zheng Qi vice minister of rites and grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，責授硤州刺史陸扆為工部尚書。

translations.literal: On guichou, demoted Xiazhou Prefect Lu Yi was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou demoted Lu Yi was made minister of works.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，華州防城將花重武告睦王已下八王欲謀殺韓建，移車駕幸河中。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Huazhou defense officer Hua Chongwu reported that Princes of Mu and seven others plotted to kill Han Jian and move the carriage to Hezhong.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Hua Chongwu reported eight princes plotted to kill Han Jian and move the court to Hezhong.

sentences.zh: 帝聞之駭然，召韓建諭之，建辭疾不敢行。

translations.literal: The emperor was alarmed and summoned Jian to instruct him; Jian pleaded illness and dared not come.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was alarmed and summoned Jian; Jian pleaded illness and dared not come.

sentences.zh: 帝即令通王已下詣建治所自陳。

translations.literal: The emperor at once ordered Princes of Tong and below to Jian's office to explain themselves.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Princes of Tong and below to Jian's office to explain.

sentences.zh: 建奏曰：「今日未時，睦王、濟王、韶王、通王、彭王、韓王、儀王、陳王等八人到臣治所，不測事由。

translations.literal: Jian memorialized: "Today at the wei hour Princes of Mu, Ji, Shao, Tong, Peng, Han, Yi, and Chen—eight in all—came to my office for reasons I could not fathom.
translations.idiomatic: Jian memorialized: "At wei hour today eight princes came to my office for reasons I could not fathom.

sentences.zh: 臣酌量事體，不合與諸王相見，兼恐久在臣所，於事非宜。

translations.literal: I weighed the matter and should not meet the princes; I also feared long stay at my office would be unfitting.
translations.idiomatic: I judged I should not meet them and feared their long stay was unfitting.

sentences.zh: 況睦王等與臣中外事殊，尊卑禮隔，至於事柄，未有相侵，忽然及門，意不可測。

translations.literal: Moreover the princes and I differ in inner and outer affairs, in honor and rank; as to power, we did not encroach—yet they suddenly came to my door, their intent beyond measure."
